title: ESP32 Weather Station Carrier Board
description: Indoor carrier/shield for ESP32 DevKit v1 (30-pin), SINGLE-SIDED PCB (bottom copper only, top wire jumpers JW*): AHT20+BMP280, LCD2004 I2C, DS1302 RTC, 4 buttons, 3 LEDs, buzzer.
